title: rosa tomentosa f. farinulenta
intro: Rosa tomentosa f. farinulenta, commonly known as the "woolly rose", is a plant species that belongs to the Rosaceae family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, helping to protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of Rosa tomentosa f. farinulenta include wound healing, antimicrobial, and antiviral activities, making it a potential treatment for various skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
